as_told.title: Special forces unit fought a giant in Afghan caves

plain: This story is about a giant said to have been found in a cave in the Kandahar region of Afghanistan in 2005. A guest named Tim Alberino says a team of American scouts was killed there, and that soldiers found a huge human-like creature eating one of them before they shot it down. The podcast host, Jesse Michels, repeats it more briefly, saying a soldier claims his unit fought the giant in the caves, without mentioning a date, a place or the scouts being eaten. People tell it because, if true, it would mean giant beings have been met by the US military.
